sections.title: Several courses in one order
sections.content: In a restaurant you order the courses together. Say *kérnék* or *szeretnék* once and join the dishes with *és*. Every dish keeps its *-t*: *Kérnék egy levest és egy főételt.* The waiter uses the *ő* form for "you": *Mit szeretne?* Between friends at the table: *Mit szeretnél?*

sections.title: Meat words
sections.content: *Marhahús* and *sertéshús* are built from *marha* (cow) and *sertés* (pig) plus *hús* (meat). A *menü* is a set meal at a fixed price, usually soup, a main course and a dessert.

items.spanish: Kérnék egy levest és egy főételt.
items.english: I would like a soup and a main course.
I would like beef and a side dish.
I would like a set menu.
What would you like to eat?

sections.content: Only the first verb needs *kérnék* or *szeretnék*. You do not repeat it for each dish, but each dish keeps its *-t*: *levest és főételt*.
